solution.name: Shopify abandoned cart recovery
solution.metaDescription: Whaleal Cart detects abandoned Shopify checkouts in real time and sends timed recovery emails — plus an optional single text — from inside your Shopify admin.
solution.lede: An abandoned checkout is not a lost visitor. It is a customer who got as far as the payment step. Whaleal Cart watches for that moment and follows up automatically, so the recovery does not depend on someone remembering to check a report.

sections.h: What counts as an abandoned checkout
p: Shopify records a checkout when a customer reaches the payment step. When that checkout is never completed, it becomes recoverable — and the window to recover it is short: the customer still remembers the store, the cart and the intent.
Whaleal Cart captures those checkouts as they happen. There is no export, no spreadsheet and no manual list to work from: the moment a checkout is abandoned it enters a recovery sequence.

The default sequence is timed email: a first message around one hour after the checkout is abandoned, and a follow-up around twenty-four hours later. Both windows are configurable, and the sequence can be switched off per store.
If you want a second channel, there is an optional text (SMS) channel with its own send delay, independent from the email timing. You can run both channels, or just one.
bullets: First recovery email — around 1 hour after abandonment
Follow-up email — around 24 hours after abandonment
Optional SMS — its own delay, independent of the email sequence

p: Every recovery message is assembled from a template: the customer name, the items left behind, the order total and currency, the return link, and a discount code if you attach one. Personalization comes from the template and the checkout itself — not from a language model.
Everything is embedded in the Shopify admin you already use. There is no second dashboard to log into, no code to deploy, and billing runs through Shopify together with the rest of your subscription.

Recovery messages go to customers who abandoned a checkout — one recovery message per checkout per channel — rather than to a purchased list. Consent rules and opt-out obligations stay with you, which is where they belong.

faq.q: Do I need a separate SMS provider?
faq.a: Only if you turn the text channel on. The SMS channel works with your own SMS account and its API key — you keep your provider relationship, your negotiated rate and your invoice. If you never enable it, email alone runs the recovery sequence.

faq.q: Does the AI write the whole email?
faq.a: No. AI drafting is optional and limited to three parts: a subject line, a heading and a short intro. Everything else — name, items, totals, currency, discount, links — is filled in by your template. Anything AI drafts must be reviewed and switched on by you before it goes out.

faq.q: How quickly does recovery start after install?
faq.a: Detection begins as soon as the app is installed and the sequence is enabled. Checkouts abandoned before that point are not retroactively messaged.
